outcome: spectrum of congenital anomalies (types of anomalies)
cohort: The study included 86850 live births at a tertiary care centre in north India from January 1998 to December 2017.
finding: The overall prevalence of major congenital anomalies was 182 per 10,000 live births, with circulatory system malformations being the most common, and a congenital anomaly-related death rate of 6.78 per 1000 live births, with no significant trends observed over two decades.
